source.version_difference: CN and EN align at all 241 text-bearing source positions by physical line and type. EN has one additional terminal newline. The 549 non-text control commands match exactly. Speaker labels and text payloads are localized: 55 Sticker, 12 Subtitle, five Decision, and two multiline payloads differ by language. No source command-parameter differences were found. The translated first segment contains 40 positions (29 named, 11 narration); its command lines and markup align exactly.

documented_meaning_differences.cn_summary: Scareye insists that Ascalon did not kill him.
documented_meaning_differences.en_summary: EN recasts the opening as a rhetorical dismissal of the prophecy.
documented_meaning_differences.ru_summary: Аскалон меня не убила! Не убила!
documented_meaning_differences.resolution: Russian preserves the repeated CN assertion.

documented_meaning_differences.cn_summary: CN calls the Cyclops Court a huge joke.
documented_meaning_differences.ru_summary: Королевский двор циклопов — одна большая шутка!
documented_meaning_differences.resolution: Russian follows CN and omits the added adjective.

documented_meaning_differences.cn_summary: CN repeats that Scareye did not die at Ascalon's hands, then refers to his own prophecy.
documented_meaning_differences.ru_summary: Я не погиб от руки Аскалон. Не погиб так, как сам себе предсказывал…
documented_meaning_differences.resolution: Russian keeps the repeated denial in a concise Russian form.

documented_meaning_differences.cn_summary: CN says the mercenaries can return to the Scar Market and secure their position if Babel loses.
documented_meaning_differences.en_summary: EN reduces the consequence to 'nothing to lose'.
documented_meaning_differences.resolution: Russian follows the CN reference to their position.

documented_meaning_differences.cn_summary: CN explicitly identifies the men as ambushers Scareye himself placed there.
documented_meaning_differences.en_summary: EN calls them soldiers he set up for an ambush.
documented_meaning_differences.ru_summary: …наёмников, которых сам же расставил здесь в засаде.
documented_meaning_differences.resolution: Russian retains the ambush and Scareye's responsibility.

documented_meaning_differences.cn_summary: CN says Theresis respects compatriots who come before him one after another at the cost of their lives.
documented_meaning_differences.en_summary: EN adds an explanation about fighting their way out.
documented_meaning_differences.ru_summary: …сородичей, которые один за другим пробивались к нему, ставя на кон собственную жизнь.
documented_meaning_differences.resolution: Russian follows the CN image without adding the EN explanation.

documented_meaning_differences.cn_summary: CN says the traitors lying in ambush around them have probably prepared for a long time.
documented_meaning_differences.en_summary: EN adds the metaphor of sharpening their blades.
documented_meaning_differences.resolution: Russian follows CN and does not add the sharpening metaphor.

notes: The original CN and EN game scripts were read from the attributed Kengxxiao mirrors; no complete source scripts are copied into this repository.
The source contains 241 text-bearing positions: 141 named, 26 narration, 55 Sticker, two multiline, 12 Subtitle and five Decision positions.
CN has 790 physical lines; EN has 791 because of one extra terminal newline. The 241 text positions align by source line and type.
The 549 non-text control commands match exactly. The 74 text-bearing command payloads are localized content, not structural command differences.
This update translates only ordinals 1–40, source lines 12–144. The next text position is ordinal 41 at source line 158.
The scene remains partial at 40/241. Literary review and Yostar Global PC in-game validation have not been performed.
